intuition: The zigzag path moves down through the rows, then diagonally upward, repeating that cycle.

brute_force.approach: Place characters into a full two-dimensional grid and read the rows.

optimal.approach: Append each character directly to its current row while reversing direction at the top and bottom.

edge_cases: One row produces the original string.
More rows than characters also leaves the input order unchanged.
The direction changes at both boundary rows.
